hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0001 = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y); G0002 = dF/dz evaluated at z=x, interpreted as df(x).
required_assumptions: df(x) denotes the first derivative of f(x) with respect to x
The coincident-point limit lim_{y->x} (f(x)-f(y))/(x-y) exists and equals df(x)
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The two catalog expressions share a single latent function F: G0001 is the first-order divided difference over the pair x,y, and G0002 is the coincident-point derivative obtained from that divided difference in the limit y->x.
